clinical_intent: I have a 70-year-old male with prostate cancer (Gleason 3+4, Stage T2a, PSA 8.5) who has severe anxiety disorder requiring ongoing benzodiazepine therapy. He wants LDR brachytherapy but is very anxious about the procedure. How should I manage his anxiety during the procedure? Should I recommend general anesthesia versus local anesthesia? What modifications to the brachytherapy procedure are needed for anxious patients? Should I consider alternative treatment approaches?
